notes: New upper bound: x0 = 10439679896374780276373 (odd, 23 digits) is not of the form +-p^a +- 2^b (p prime, a, b >= 0): covering mod 720 by the 18 primes 3..331 for x0 - 2^b and x0 + 2^b, exclusion of x0 -+ 2^b = +-p^a in the 771 single-prime classes by congruences mod 2^20 and auxiliary primes q with ord_q(2) | 720, and direct check of b < 795; two independent verifiers (sympy, PARI). Old bound 47867742232066880047611079 (Cohen-Selfridge/Sun), about 4600 times larger. New lower bound: every odd n < 42565109 is p^a +- 2^b or 2^b - p^a with proved primes (old 2^18); up to 2^28 all odd n except 42565109, 52274777 (PRP-only representations, b = 5945 and 16116) and 111827383 (none with b <= 26000). Minimum prime product of a two-sided covering with moduli | 720 (primes < 1e7) is about 10^28.52 (ILP). Outside Lean: all (C/PARI/sympy computations; PARI isprime proofs for b > 62).
